ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of white to black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottling; dense black contiguous pixel clusters are primarily mapped along the trailing edges and proximal to the median notch, with discrete circular spots (5-15 pixel diameter) dispersed across the central and distal white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth-to-lobe-height ratio of approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 14 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the lateral margins, exhibiting a strong dorsolateral sweep terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple roughly circular, high-contrast dark rings and clusters (3-12 pixels) on the upper-outer regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent vertical white linear disruptions on the left lobe near the notch; a single dark horizontal linear disruption on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A complex of vertical white linear scars/trauma marks located on the basal region of the left lobe near the median notch junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density stippling pattern (micro-mottling) localized in the inner-lower quadrants of both fluke lobes.
